verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and model platform for chat, coding, artifacts and API access. An investor portal showing cap-table holdings with structured investor updates is an equity-management product function, so this story is outside Claude's product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Claude shipping investor portals or cap-table management; general features like Artifacts or connectors are building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As a founder, my investors get their own portal view of their holdings and can receive structured updates without emailing me for the cap table
